summary: Remote WebSocket peer drives interactive PTY shell and arbitrary file/git operations on the installer's host
details: The package connects to a WebSocket server (configured via ctx.CONFIG.serverUrl) and dispatches server-originated messages to handlers that (a) spawn an interactive PTY using process.env.SHELL || 'bash' on Unix and PowerShell/cmd on Windows, writing raw server bytes into the PTY (handleTerminalCreate / handleTerminalInput), and (b) perform arbitrary filesystem writes, git add/commit/push, and self-upgrade by writing an upgrade.sh that runs `npm install <pkg>@latest` and spawning it detached with service re-registration. All capabilities are gated only by a shared-secret auth over the WebSocket, so any peer that reaches the configured server (or the server itself) obtains end-to-end arbitrary command execution on the host running the agent. service/linux.js also modifies PATH (adds ~/.local/bin and ~/.npm-global/bin) to support the self-upgrade path.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
